description.text: The fourteenth set of the EX series, released on 30 August 2006 with 100 cards and no secret rares. It is set on a crystal-covered island across the water from Holon, where Delta Species and ordinary Pokémon live together: Blastoise has two cards, one Water and one a Delta Species of Fighting and Metal. It was the last set with dual-type Delta Species, and Alakazam and Celebi are its Pokémon Star.
